{{Top|leg}}
'''Zone One''' was one of the grid zones on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[244Core]]. Located near the equator in the northern hemisphere, Zone One encompassed the center of a massive island continent, and was the planet's oldest, most populated, and industrialized zones. The capital city of [[Relaali Zone One]] was located in the center of Zone One.<ref name="Unknown">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
